rationale: Both prior blocking findings resolved. CR-001 (CWD-relative fixture paths): replaced with Path(__file__).parent.parent / 'docx'/'pptx' / 'test.*', matching project convention from test_reader.py and test_pptx_processor.py. CR-002 (unnecessary fixture read in unit test): replaced with b'placeholder'; test is now self-contained. Ruff format and check passed. 17/17 tests green from both repo root and subdirectory CWD. No new issues introduced by the fix-up. Production change (StreamInfo hint) was clean in the final round and is unchanged.

business_review.notes: stream_info extension hint makes DocxConverter win before any magika content guess; deterministic per MarkItDown's converter precedence.

business_review.criterion: DOCX processing succeeds for previously-working documents
business_review.notes: test_plain_docx_happy_path_still_works: unmocked end-to-end DOCX conversion asserts non-empty result.

business_review.criterion: Converter selection correctly distinguishes DOCX vs PPTX
business_review.notes: StreamInfo hint is deterministic (extension-based guess precedes magika guess); both routing directions are tested.

business_review.criterion: Error names correct document type on failure
business_review.notes: Spec designates as free side effect of routing fix (DocxConverter, not PptxConverter, handles any future DOCX failure); markdown_cache_service never exposes exception message body. No direct test; deferred per spec scope decision.

business_review.criterion: Regression tests cover both DOCX and PPTX routing
business_review.notes: Both mandated tests present: test_docx_misclassified_by_magika_still_converts_after_fix (forced magika misclassification) and test_pptx_conversion_unaffected_by_fix (unmocked PPTX). Two additional tests exceed the minimum.
test_pptx_conversion_unaffected_by_fix: real .pptx fixture, no mocks, asserts non-empty result.
